text: On November 2, 2020, the Corporations Nominating Panel conducted interviews and recommended one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board.

City Council on November 25 and 26, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Michael Eubanks to the Toronto Hydro Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on March 5, 2022, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 5 to the report (October 22, 2020) from the Interim City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board. Confidential Attachments 1 to 5 to the report (October 22, 2020) from the Interim City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board.
